snippet.title: Engine of Sin announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam ⇒ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4089140/Engine_Of_Sin/

Engine of Sin is a mech simulator where you operate a titan-scale war machine against monstrous Kaiju.

-Manage reactor overheat, maintain life support, fire apocalypse-grade weapons
-Fight unique Kaiju
-Explore four decks within mech
